findings.problem: The review_ai_suggestion RPC (used in production with Supabase) never checks that the confirmed reminder time lies in the future when the client sends no remind_at. The TS route also sends the suggestion's stored proposed_reminder only when edited, so an unedited confirm passes null for remind/due and the RPC creates a task with no reminder and no due date.
findings.scenario: A user taps Confirm without pressing Edit on a suggestion with a proposed reminder. The body carries only action and timeZone, so the RPC receives p_remind_at null and p_due_at null. The task is created with no due date and no reminder, and the suggestion is marked confirmed. The reminder the review screen showed is silently lost.

findings.problem: The route passes only the client-supplied dueAt/remindAt/title to the RPC, with no fallback to the stored suggestion values. The in-memory path falls back to them, so tests pass while production behaves differently.
findings.scenario: Same as above: on real Supabase an unedited Confirm gives a title-null error. p_title is null, so the RPC returns 400 'Check the task and reminder time' and Confirm never works without pressing Edit first.

findings.problem: Providers that report no usage.cost field (many OpenAI-compatible APIs) are treated as errors, so a successful, paid call is recorded as failed and no suggestions are saved.
findings.scenario: The user saves a note and the provider returns valid JSON with prompt_tokens and completion_tokens but no cost. The worker throws, the job is marked failed, and the user never sees any suggestion.

findings.problem: Jobs are only processed once, in after() right after the save, for the single user. A job that fails to claim (lease, transient error, budget) is never retried because no cron or retry path calls processNextAiJob.
findings.scenario: A provider outage fails a job. After the provider recovers, nothing reprocesses it, so that note never gets suggestions unless the user edits it.

findings.problem: In edit mode an emptied date field is sent as an empty value and cannot clear a proposed date, because the server falls back to the suggestion's stored value (`decision.remindAt ?? suggestion.proposed_reminder`).
findings.scenario: The user clears the Reminder field to confirm a task without a reminder. The server still creates the original proposed reminder.
